author: Yffe
content: Fix landed (forge/src/check.rs, single file): generalize the validator's DIRECT self-call rule (REQ-2, block_calls_name) to a CALL-GRAPH CYCLE. New fn mutual_recursion_cycle_fns reuses closure::reachable_in_file_fns — f is in a mutual cycle iff it shares an SCC (size >= 2) with some other fn g (g reachable from f AND f reachable from g). Pure direct self-recursion (f->f) excluded (REQ-2, dec-supported); fx diverge exempt (#88). The per-item loop emits Certificate::rejected (L0, MutualRecursionUnsupported) per cycle member BEFORE lowering/verus — a parseable verdict-in-cert (no false L3, no crash), matching the single-fn non-decreasing L0 precedent (REQ-4/AC-2), instead of the prior ForgeError::VerusOutput VIR-crash. Pinned test un-ignored + passing.
